title: Polynomial-time BPP in the second level
statement: If a language $L$ has a polynomial-time randomized verifier that uses polynomially many random bits and answers correctly with probability at least $2/3$ on every input, then $L$ belongs to both $\Sigma_2^P$ and $\Pi_2^P$. Here these classes are defined by polynomially bounded alternating quantifiers over witnesses and a polynomial-time decidable predicate.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ has a verifier satisfying the formal definition of membership in BPP for the polynomial-time verifier model
